An integrable uniformly decaying phenotype transient and Gronwall on the stretched time give the sigma-squared cubic crossover uniformly on compact positive times. Standalone checker verifies rational moments, aggregate dynamics and full finite-noise numeric examples, without substituting finite experiments for infinite proofs.

At that scientifically motivated degeneracy, the exact finite-noise selected level and noncommuting noise/time limits clarify which ecological prediction survives arbitrarily large but finite noise, while the proven sigma-squared relaxation clock and cubic limit quantify the approach.
